note: Searched ArcGIS Hub/Online and web. Mitchell County (13205) publishes no public ArcGIS REST parcel service or file download. Its parcel viewer is qPublic (Schneider Corp web app; no public REST endpoint found; returns 403 to automated reads). The county assessor page links only to qPublic. Parcel data appears only via commercial vendors (Dynamo Spatial, Regrid, Acres, Equator Studios), which are not county-published. Dougherty County's Parcels_Public_View service covers Dougherty only.
